description: This file defines the AesDecryptingStream class in the Aws\Crypto namespace, which implements a stream interface for decrypting data streams using AES cipher. It provides methods to read decrypted data, retrieve cipher information, and manage stream position, primarily for internal use within the AWS SDK's cryptography component.

classes.name: AesDecryptingStream
classes.description: A class that provides a decrypting stream for AES encrypted data, supporting reading and seeking (rewinding) within the stream.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decrypting stream with cipher text stream, encryption key, and cipher method.

methods.name: getOpenSslName
methods.description: Returns the OpenSSL cipher name associated with the cipher method.

methods.name: getAesName
methods.description: Returns the AES name associated with the cipher method.

methods.name: getCurrentIv
methods.description: Returns the current initialization vector from the cipher method.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the decrypted data, or null if padding is required.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not writable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads decrypted data of specified length from the stream.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Rewinds the stream; only supports rewinding to the beginning.

methods.name: decryptBlock
methods.description: Decrypts a block of cipher text read from the underlying stream.
